sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay in Stars and Clouds is straightforward – your goal is to collect stars that appear between moving clouds. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not as simple as it seems. The clouds move rapidly, and the stars appear for a limited time. You'll need to time your movements perfectly to collect all the stars in each level. The hourglass adds an extra layer of complexity, as you'll need to manage your time wisely to avoid running out. The game also features a variety of power-ups, such as speed boosts and extra time, which can be used to gain an advantage over your opponents.

The controls in Stars and Clouds are intuitive and easy to use, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels. You can use a mouse, keyboard, or even touch controls to navigate the game. The game's physics engine is well-implemented, ensuring that the stars and clouds move smoothly and realistically.

One of the strengths of Stars and Clouds is its ability to adjust the difficulty level according to the player's performance. As you complete levels, the game will gradually increase the difficulty level, introducing new challenges and obstacles. This ensures that the game remains engaging and challenging throughout, even for seasoned players.
